acceptanceCriteria: A destructured or method parameter shadowing an imported shared constant is not counted as a read
A later-scope shadow does not force ALL
Regression tests in internal/contextindex cover each form
body: Residual from PR #1096 review fix (V1-1698). Simple parameter/declaration shadowing is handled, but destructured and method parameters and later uses of a shadowed name in the same scope still over-select or return ALL. Conservative (no fail-open) but noisy.
title: tests setup-select shared-constant reads lack lexical scope analysis: later-shadowed names over-select or force ALL
